maddeler.e:
ينتهزون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَهِزُونَ (yantahizūna) /jan.ta.hi.zuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# يُنْتَهَزُونَ (yuntahazūna) /jun.ta.ha.zuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
